observation_scope: 200 historical validation firm-years across 2007–2022; raw identifiers and coordinates excluded
sample_selection: Previously saved historical 200-point-year sample, not newly stratified ecological or geocoding validation
limitations: NoData mask ignored and all numeric zero pixels retained
No scale/offset applied to original digital numbers
Numerical replication does not validate ecological interpretation
source_file_md5_comparison: All 16 research-panel annual files match official CFATD provider file sizes and MD5 checksums; no file changed during its complete read.
zero_pixel_note: These counts pool overlapping sampled windows across different years; they are not a unique land-area sample or evidence of ecological absence. Native NoData masks identify zero cells as invalid under that mask.
comparison_precision: Point values compared exactly; square means compared after the original four-decimal formatting. Zero discrepancy describes agreement at this serialization precision, not unrounded floating-point equality.
